restaurant_name: Dr.Tooth We Trust Dental Clinic
text:
I used their services two years ago, using social security insurance for a teeth cleaning. There were no extra charges. The dentist was excellent, and the staff were lovely. I even recommended them to friends.

However, this year, using social security insurance, they charged an extra 100฿ (for tooth coating), which should have been mentioned during the appointment. I only found out while lying down next to the dentist, and the dentist informed me before the procedure.

I was already frowning at the extra 100฿. The teeth cleaning was messy; water flowed up to the back of my neck and splashed everywhere—more than at a salon. It was finished in 9 minutes, and then they gave me a tooth coating to hold for another 5 minutes.

My first impression from this visit is completely gone.
